hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad token pools that gates swaps until a scheduled activation time, takes configurable WETH trading fees (time-decaying anti-snipe for Standard launches or market-cap-decaying for Meme launches), and routes creator fees through a flywheel to buyback-burn, auto-LP, token reflections, or WETH dividends.
